# Pen & Press Publishing

> Pen & Press Publishing is a Christian formation publishing house based in Michigan, founded by Lev Montgomery. It publishes devotional books and The Pen & Press Vanguard on Substack. Pen & Press Publishing is a DBA of Pen & Press Holdings LLC.

## Books by Lev Montgomery
- Before the Day: A 90-Day Devotional for Souls Being Quietly Formed. Released August 21, 2026, with a Companion Study Guide.
- A Light Has Come: An Advent Vigil in the Glory of Christ Incarnate. A 21-day Advent devotional. Released November 12, 2026.
- Flashes of Fire: 66 Devotionals and Prayers Across Scripture. Released December 2025.

## Publication lines
- Morning Mastery: the weekday devotional. One passage of Scripture, one truth to carry, one prayer.
- The Inner Court: Sunday-evening prayer formation.
- The Plumb Line: civic discipleship.
- The Pen & Press Exposition: exposition and conviction essays.
- The Four Watches: the Scripture rail on the website. A King James verse at midnight, sunrise, noon, and sunset, Eastern time, through the whole Bible over thirty-one days.

## Where to read and buy
- Website: https://penpresspublishing.com/
- The Pen & Press Vanguard (Substack): https://levmontgomery.substack.com/
- The books are sold on Amazon and direct from the house. Group quotes for churches and fellowships are requested on the website.

## Press
